remarks: This completely renovated one-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment in the heart of Norwalk offers modern comfort and convenience. A thoughtfully designed space, this first-floor unit features an eat-in kitchen with stainless appliances, a bright living room, and a cozy bedroom. The full bathroom includes a shower and tub combination, providing both functionality and comfort. Also included in the unit are a washer and dryer, as well as a dishwasher for added convenience. Tenants will also have access to additional storage in the basement and off-street parking. Located close to shopping, dining, healthcare, major highways, and public transportation, this apartment offers easy access to everything Norwalk has to offer. Move-in ready and beautifully updated, this is a great opportunity for those looking for a comfortable and stylish home.
